title: Complexity Lens configuration
description: Rules for Complexity Lens. Every option is optional; anything left out comes from the preset.

limit.markdownDescription: Set to `null` to turn this check off.

limits.markdownDescription: When something counts as **too much**. Set any limit to `null` to turn that check off.

cognitiveComplexity.markdownDescription:
**How hard a function is to follow.** Adds 1 for each `if`, `else`, loop, `catch`, ternary, `switch`, labelled jump and each mixed `&&`/`||`/`??` chain, plus extra for every level of nesting. High scores are where AI edits introduce bugs.

Presets: relaxed 25 · recommended 15 · strict 10.

functionLines.markdownDescription:
**Length of one function, in lines.** Long functions must be read in full to edit safely.

Presets: relaxed 100 · recommended 60 · strict 40.

nestingDepth.markdownDescription:
**How many `if` / loop / `switch` / `try` levels sit inside each other.** Deep nesting is the most common source of AI logic mistakes.

Presets: relaxed 5 · recommended 4 · strict 3.

parameters.markdownDescription:
**Inputs a function takes.** Many parameters often means the function does too much.

Presets: relaxed 7 · recommended 5 · strict 4.

fileLines.markdownDescription:
**Length of a file, in lines.** Big files cost tokens every time an AI opens them.

Presets: relaxed 800 · recommended 400 · strict 300.

fileTokens.markdownDescription:
**Estimated tokens to read the file** (about 3.5 characters per token; an estimate, not exact). The direct "AI reading cost".

Presets: relaxed 16000 · recommended 8000 · strict 6000.

imports.markdownDescription:
**How many other modules this file depends on.** Each import is more code an AI may need to read.

Presets: relaxed 25 · recommended 15 · strict 12.

markdownEnumDescriptions: **Don't make it worse.** New functions must be under the limits; existing ones may stay over them but an edit can't push them higher. Untouched code is never flagged.
**Everything must be under the limits.** Anything over a limit in the checked files is flagged, even if it wasn't changed. Best for new projects.

hook.markdownDescription: **Agent hook**: checks code while an AI agent edits it (PostToolUse / Stop command hooks).

markdownEnumDescriptions: The agent gets a note about new problems; it may act on it or not.
The agent gets the problems as something it must respond to (fix it or explain) before continuing. The edit itself is kept.

onFinish.markdownDescription: What happens **when the agent tries to end its turn**. Checks every file changed since the last commit.
markdownEnumDescriptions: You get a summary of anything still over the limits.
The agent can't finish while a file it changed has problems (judged by `policy`). After `maxRetries` attempts it may finish and the problems are reported to you instead.

maxRetries.markdownDescription: How many times `onFinish: "block"` sends the agent back before letting it finish and reporting to you. Prevents endless loops when something can't be simplified.

allowComment.markdownDescription: **Escape hatch**: a comment above a function that accepts it as is, e.g. `// complexity-ok: parser state machine`. Accepted functions are still shown, but never block.

marker.markdownDescription: The word to look for (3–40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens). Default `complexity-ok`.

requireReason.markdownDescription: Require a reason after the marker (`// complexity-ok: <reason>`), so reviewers see why. Default `true`.

preset.markdownDescription: **Starting point.** Anything you set explicitly overrides it.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Higher limits, the hook only informs, CI off. For trying it on a big existing codebase.
Balanced: nudge after each edit, block on finish (ratchet, 2 retries), CI warns.
Lower limits, absolute policy, CI fails on anything over a limit. For new projects.

include.markdownDescription: **Files to measure**, relative to the repo root. Supports `**`, `*`, `?` and `{a,b}`. Default: every TypeScript/JavaScript file in the repo.

exclude.markdownDescription: **Files to skip**: tests, generated code, build output. Same pattern syntax as `include`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Annotations on changed lines that got worse; the check still passes.
The check fails if the pull request made something worse beyond a limit.
The check fails if any changed file has anything over a limit.

includeImports.markdownDescription: When estimating **AI cost**, also count the files this file imports, this many levels deep (`0` = the file alone). Default `1`.

historyDays.markdownDescription: How far back in git history to count changes for **hotspots** (complexity × how often a file changed). Default `90`.

overrides.markdownDescription: **Different rules for parts of the repo**, applied in order. Example: `{ "files": ["src/legacy/**"], "hook": { "onFinish": "inform" } }`.

files.markdownDescription: Which files this override applies to.
